description: Implementation of GSIMReadPlatformService for accessing Group Savings Individual Monitoring (GSIM) account data, including methods for retrieving account containers by group ID, account number, or account ID, and mapping database result sets to data objects.

classes.name: GSIMFieldsMapper
classes.description: Maps database result set rows to GroupSavingsIndividualMonitoringAccountData objects for GSIM account summaries.

classes.name: GSIMMapper
classes.description: Maps database result set rows to GroupSavingsIndividualMonitoringAccountData objects for GSIM account summaries.

classes.name: SavingsAccountSummaryDataMapper
classes.description: Maps database result set rows to SavingsSummaryCustom objects for savings account summaries.

methods.name: findGSIMAccountContainerByGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves GSIM containers for a specific group ID, including associated savings account details.

methods.name: findGsimAccountContainerbyGsimAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves GSIM containers based on a parent account number.

methods.name: findGsimAccountContainerbyGsimAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves GSIM container for a specific GSIM account ID.

methods.name: findGSIMAccountsByGSIMId
methods.description: Retrieves GSIM account data collection by GSIM ID.

methods.name: findGSIMAccountByGSIMId
methods.description: Retrieves a single GSIM account data object by GSIM ID.

methods.name: findGSIMAccountsByGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves GSIM account data collection by group ID.

methods.name: findGsimAccountByParentAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves GSIM account data collection by parent account number.

methods.name: findGsimAccountByGroupIdandAccountNo
methods.description: Retrieves GSIM account data collection by group ID and account number.

methods.name: retrieveAccountDetails
methods.description: Executes SQL query to retrieve savings account details based on provided where clause and parameters.
